text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I appear on a live TV program, and they even prepared a special cake to celebrate my efforts… But I'm not fit to be a princess! I don't deserve this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've acted like I was the only heroine and behaved in a self-centered manner. I've hurt so many people…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Trainer promises to grow alongside me and improve together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I'm sorry! I promise I won't be an embarrassment of a princess anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Kinko Sho. I'll seal away my princess special moves until everyone accepts me…
